record.question: Under Section 126 of BNSS, 2023 in which circumstances can an Executive Magistrate require a person to execute a bond for keeping the peace?
options: Only when a breach of the peace has already occurred
Only when the person has a criminal record
When the Executive Magistrate receives information that such person is likely to commit a breach of the peace or disturb public tranquility, and there is sufficient ground for proceeding
When there is a request from the local police
